description: Prove a consequence, by action: "now" evaluates a predicate against the window that already exists, "wait" waits for one to become true within a budget. e.g. {"action":"now"}

intent.description: What this change is meant to make true — as a durable statement ABOUT THE PRODUCT, or the id of an intent you already declared.

predicate.description: Predicate object: { kind, ...fields }. kind is one of element | text | net | route | console | animation | signal | state | settled | compare | allOf | anyOf | not.

sessionId.description: Target a specific tab. Omit unless you mean one — see instructions.

since.description: Cursor from a prior act/observe, or a git ref.

timeout_ms.description: If > 0, wait up to this many milliseconds before failing.

until.description: Predicate object: { kind, ...fields }. kind is one of element | text | net | route | console | animation | signal | state | settled | compare | allOf | anyOf | not.

name: reticle_assert
